query:
DELETE FROM guilds g
             WHERE g.id = $1
               AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM guild_presence p WHERE p.guild_id = g.id)
               AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM guild_presence p
                   WHERE p.guild_id = g.id
                     AND (p.left_at IS NULL
                          OR p.left_at > now() - make_interval(days => $2))
               )
